meta.title: Hammerprice: your profile
meta.description: Your profile, wallet, bids, wins and payments, sales and prices in one place.

title: Your profile
lede: Your wallet, your bids, your purchases and your sales in one place.
loadError: We could not load this list. Try again.

profile.title: Edit profile
profile.lede: A name and a few words about you. Everything is optional, you choose what others see, and you can change or remove it at any time.
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: Up to {max} characters: letters, digits, spaces and . , ' & ( ) _ ! - only. No links, e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
profile.bioHint: {left} characters left (up to {max}). No links or contact details.
profile.where: Your display name appears next to your chat messages (for example "Anna, Bidder 7") and as the seller on your rooms. Bids and the bid log always show your bidding number only. Your username, short text and picture are shown on your profile page only.
profile.loadError: We could not load your profile. Reload the page to try again.
profile.saveError: We could not save your profile. Try again in a moment.
profile.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to save.
profile.rateLimited: You changed your profile very often. Try again in {wait}.

rules.too_short: That is too short. At least {min} characters.
rules.too_long: That is too long. At most {max} characters.
rules.characters: Use letters, digits, spaces and . , ' & ( ) _ ! - only.
rules.contact_data: E-mail addresses, handles, phone numbers and wallet addresses are not allowed here.
rules.reserved: That name is reserved. Please choose another.
rules.avatar_https: The picture address must start with https://.
rules.avatar_host: The picture must be hosted on an allowed address (https://*.cloudfront.net).
rules.avatar_invalid: That is not a usable picture address.
rules.taken: That username is already taken. Please choose another.
rules.avatar_type: The picture must be a png, jpeg or webp image.
rules.avatar_size: The picture is too large (200 KB at most).

profile.usernameHint: {min} to {max} characters: letters, digits and underscores. It is unique. Your username is shown on your profile page only. The chat shows your display name, if you set one, and always your bidder number.

header.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
header.strikesNote: A warning is added when a sale is not paid or delivered in time. At 20 warnings your bidding number is suspended.
header.loadError: We could not load your profile. Reload the page to try again.

wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.availableHint: Your USDC balance minus what you already lead or owe.
wallet.cardsLede: Cards your wallet holds, as far as the network lets us read them.
wallet.cardsEmpty: No cards found in your wallet.
wallet.cardsError: We could not read the cards in your wallet right now.

sales.roomsEmpty: You have not created a room yet.

prices.title: Prices overview
prices.note: Computed from your completed (settled) purchases and sales only. Open or failed payments are not counted.
prices.empty: No completed purchase or sale yet. Your numbers appear here after the first one.
prices.loadError: We could not load your numbers right now.

credits.title: AI credits
credits.lede: Credits pay for AI listing drafts in the sell wizard. One credit is one draft.
credits.loadError: We could not load your credits right now.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.lede: Inside Hammerprice, everything that needs you is listed under Wins and payments, and the banner at the top of this page tells you when something waits. Messages to your phone go through Telegram, when the operator has switched it on for this site.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.lede: Disconnecting signs you out of Hammerprice and disconnects your wallet in this browser. Your account, your bids and your sales stay as they are. You can sign in again at any time with a signature.
danger.data: You can clear your username, display name, short text and picture under Profile at any time. They are then deleted from our database.

avatar.title: Picture
avatar.hint: png, jpeg or webp, up to 200 KB. No SVG. Shown on your profile page only. We keep the file exactly as you upload it, so remove hidden data such as a location from it first.
avatar.wrongType: That file is not a png, jpeg or webp picture.
avatar.tooBig: That picture is larger than 200 KB. Choose a smaller one.
avatar.failed: We could not save your picture. Try again in a moment.
avatar.rateLimited: You changed your picture very often. Try again in {wait}.
avatar.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to save.
